subject: general
question: Seven boxes G, H, I, K, L, M and S are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only four boxes are kept between I and K. Only S is kept above I. Only two boxes are kept between M and G. H is kept immediately above L. G is not kept immediately above H. Which box is kept fourth from the top?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes G, H, I, K, L, M and S are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only four boxes are kept between I and K.
 
• Only S is kept above I.
 
• Only two boxes are kept between M and G.
 
• H is kept immediately above L.
 
• G is not kept immediately above H. 

The final arrangement is

 
• 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
S

 
 
 

 
 
I

 
 
 

 
 
M

 
 
 

 
 
H

 
 
 

 
 
L

 
 
 

 
 
G

 
 
 

 
 
K

 
 
 
 
 
 
• H is kept fourth from the top
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
